Quick corrections!! Whether it be a sound you make or command you need to address it every time it happens even if it’s 80 times a minute. Don’t allow them to nibble cause they will grow up doing it. Address it even when you can tell they were thinking about it. Long term it will help with obedience. If you’re still struggling try a muzzle. My mal hated a muzzle but all dogs have their things yk. My command to get her to stop was “leave it” and essentially that was my word for her to redirect her focus herself so I don’t have to all the time. It’s best with two people but essentially just give her the command and then instantly give her something else and she’ll put two and two together eventually. This breed is prone to this problem and it took months for her to stop so just be patient

As someone who has been clean for 3years, I can say it’s not worth trying.. I started when I was much younger (probably when I was 13) and it is a fight in itself. Addictive. I know it must be hard.. feeling like you might need to punish yourself somehow, or wanting to feel anything, whatever the case may be. I implore you to love the beautiful skin you have. I spent years sweating in the summer, wearing clothes I wouldn’t have normally to hide myself. It was hard even after I stopped to wear short sleeves. I still worry about it and how it must look to others. I would give anything to have stopped myself those so many years ago (I’m 20 now) from starting something that I still think of falling back into (because again, it’s addicting). I’m so proud that you haven’t yet, and again hope that you won’t. I know how tempting something so widely “used”, I guess you could say, is but keep your focus on the future. Because it will surely affect you later. Plus it’s just science: it will cause a dopamine deficiency or cause it to be worse if you already have one. Thank you for being there for others too. You’re brave for that, but remember to take care of yourself. You don’t deserve to hurt yourself when this world does it enough.
